desc: Must: complete the 40-case A5 review and acceptance oracle
done_when: All 40 TestOracleA5/<id> inventory cases pass; A5-filtered regen reproduces every golden from 96c9ad69a; TestA5GoldenSensitivity proves one altered byte fails live and regen; the diff adds files only under internal/oracle/a5/.
scope: New internal/oracle/a5/** only: test-only driver/adapters, base and case fixtures, json/human/state goldens, sensitivity proof and testdata/acceptance-a5.json. Excludes production, existing tests, harness, ledger, other areas and TUI.
validation: env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp go test -count=1 ./internal/oracle/a5/...
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp go test -race -count=1 -run '^TestOracleA5$' ./internal/oracle/a5/...
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp go run ./internal/testhelpers/oracle/cmd/regen -pkg ./internal/oracle/a5/...
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp ORACLE_A5_TAMPER=1 go test -count=1 -run '^TestA5GoldenSensitivity$' ./internal/oracle/a5/...
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp make lint
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp make test
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp make test-e2e
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/tmp make test-race
